name: freehire
long_description:
An MCP server over [freehire.me](https://freehire.me), an open-source IT job aggregator that crawls postings straight from company career boards — 3.3M+ open roles across 294K companies, normalized into one schema and tagged with stack, seniority, region and work mode.

Search and filter the live market, score a skill list against real demand, read a posting in full, apply, track application stages, and tailor a CV against a specific job. Search results carry each posting's full description as markdown, so a host can screen a result set without a follow-up call per hit.

Authentication uses a personal API key from freehire.me. If you already use the freehire.me CLI, the server reads the key it stored and no configuration is needed.

freehire_token.title: freehire.me API key
freehire_token.description: Create one at freehire.me under the account menu -> API keys. Leave blank if the freehire.me CLI already stored a key in ~/.freehire/creds.json — the server reads that.
